description_en: After a VPC instance is connected to an Enterprise Edition transit router, you can call the ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitches operation to query information about vSwitches that are attached to multicast domains in the virtual private cloud (VPC) instance
description_zh: VPC实例连接至企业版转发路由器后，您可以调用ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitches接口查询VPC实例下已绑定组播域的交换机的信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn list-transit-router-multicast-domain-vswitches --cen-id cen-44m0p68spvlrqq0000 --vpc-id vpc-p0wr1cd4fcuxy3ui00000 --vswitchids vsw-p0w5ejr9bzfsttiza0000 --max-results 20 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitches

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC instance
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Minimum value: 0. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。最小值：0。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if there is no next query.
If there is a next query, set the value to the NextToken value that is returned from the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, there is no next query.
If NextToken has a return value, the value is the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The number of entries in the list
